descripcion: Open-source compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with the Reign of the Warlock expansion. Runs your own Switch copy natively on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and HarmonyOS — full touch controls, 60 fps, new endgame modes. Bring your own game files. 开源的《暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生》术士君临 iOS / macOS / 安卓 / 鸿蒙兼容层
